About Wing: 

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wing’s fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. We design, build, and operate our aircraft, and offer drone delivery services on two continents. Our technology is designed to be easy to integrate into existing delivery and logistics networks, offering a scalable drone delivery solution for a broad range of businesses. Wing is a part of Google's parent company, Alphabet, and our mission is to create the preferred means of delivery for the planet. If you're ready to do the greatest work of your life, come join us.

About the Program: 

Join Wing's 12-week paid summer internship! This is a hybrid, in-person program based in Palo Alto, CA, with start dates in May or June. Eligible candidates must be a current student enrolled in a degree program and intend to return to the program after the completion of the summer internship.

About the Role:

Wing is looking for a Data Scientist Intern to join our Business and Product Analytics & Data Science team based in Palo Alto, CA. You will work closely with cross-functional team members (e.g., Business Operations, Product) to turn complex business questions into clear, decision-focused data problems.

In this role, you will use advanced analytics, modeling, and statistical analysis to evaluate tradeoffs, quantify impact, and guide strategic choices. You will perform in-depth analysis to answer important questions on business trends and proactively identify insights that enable cross-functional stakeholders to make confident, data-informed decisions.

In this role you will: 



- Execute deep-dive research and advanced analytics on complex datasets to uncover patterns, interpret trends, and assist in synthesizing product and business insights.
- Support the development of predictive models to help forecast trends, measure operational trade-offs, and project business impact.
- Conduct foundational statistical analysis and assist in the setup of experimental frameworks (e.g., A/B testing, causal inference) to help test hypotheses and evaluate ongoing performance.
- Translate complex statistical outputs into clear, data-driven summaries and communicate analytical findings effectively to project team members.
- Analyze key performance indicators (KPIs), identifying key trends, undertaking follow-up analysis to uncover valuable business patterns, and communicating these insights clearly to stakeholders.

What You’ll Need: 



- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, graduating between December 2027 and August 2028
- Strong coding proficiency in Python and SQL (familiarity with R or other data analysis libraries is highly beneficial).
- Solid foundational knowledge of statistical methods including experimental design, hypothesis testing, regression modeling, and causal inference.
- Familiarity with quantitative modeling, forecasting techniques, and data analytics.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to explain mathematical or technical findings clearly to business partners.
- High degree of curiosity with a strong desire to learn, collaborate, and tackle quantitative projects from raw data to structured insights.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is the salary range below + bonus + equity + benefits. Wing’s salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process.

Salary Range: $120,000 USD - $126,000 USD

Wing is an equal opportunity employer and it is Wing's policy to comply with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity. Employment at Wing is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. Wing does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law.

Moog is a performance culture that empowers people to achieve great things. Our people enjoy solving interesting technical challenges in a culture where everyone trusts each other to do the right thing. For you, working with us can mean deeper job satisfaction, better rewards, and a great quality of life inside and outside of work.

Job Title

Intern, Software Engineering

Reporting To

Manager, Engineering

Work Schedule

Onsite – Mineral Wells, TX

The Software Engineering team within our Military Aircraft Group is seeking a summer 2027 block intern. The intern will have an onsite work schedule in Mineral Wells, TX.

To be considered for this role, here’s what you’ll need to bring with you: 



- Enrolled in a Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, and/or Electrical Engineering Bachelor's or Master's Degree program, at an accredited university. 
- GPA of at least 3.0; exact GPA requirement will be specified by department. 
- This position requires access to U.S. export-controlled information. 
- Ability to relocate for the duration of the internship. 

Students within the Moog U.S. Internship Program are expected to have a professional disposition, effective communication skills, a strong desire to learn, a positive attitude, and the ability to work in a team environment.

In This Role You Will



- Contribute to the preparation and execution of key software engineering tasks at Moog. 
- Provide technical support to engineers, as needed. 
- Work experience may include software development; software integration; software programing; and/or managing full lifecycle of flight displays, radios, autopilot systems, and sensors based on the student's educational discipline. 
- Provide input on project processes, strategies, and execution. 
- Operate as a multidisciplinary member of a team of creative, independent individuals. 
- Represent Moog in a manner consistent with its technical and professional reputation. 

How We Care For You



- Work/Life Balance: Flexible paid time off, holidays, and relocation assistance for full-time interns. 
- Collaborative and Welcoming Workplace: Inclusive culture rooted in our values, enhanced by Employee Resource Groups, and team-building activities. 
- Additional site-specific benefits may be offered. 

Salary Range Transparency

Mineral Wells, TX $25.50–$31.00 Hourly
